features: Challenger now upgrades automatically when the latest Candidate has a strictly newer schema version (for example schema v2 -> v3 DMI Expert)
Same-schema daily Candidates do not replace the current Challenger, preserving the accumulated future OOS evaluation window
When a schema upgrade supersedes the old Challenger, its candidate status is archived as SUPERSEDED_SCHEMA_UPGRADE and Champion remains unchanged
New Challenger manifests record schema_version, DMI Expert version and the replaced challenger model id for traceability
HistoricalTraining daily-learning already calls challenger/ensure after Candidate upload, so no HistoricalTraining workflow change is required
Existing schema v3 DMI probability_reader integration, S-state rules, ADX/DMI formulas, schedules and promotion/rejection gates are unchanged
